messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: service=embed-service image=embed-service:v3.4.0 -> v3.5.0. staged 10% traffic now. change-window=2024-08-22T18:00Z :rocket:

tara: saw a small p95 blip on embeddings in eu-west at ~18:02, +50ms over baseline. digging in but wanted to flag. :eyes:

obs-bot: SLO ALERT (eu-west): embeddings.p95 = 340ms (baseline 290ms) over 5m window. error rate stable.

mike: putting dashboards up — looks correlated to long-tail token lengths for a subset of requests. rerouting 100% of canary to a smaller batch size might help.

jen: can we pause the rollout at 10% until we confirm? prefer to pin to v3.4.0 for customer-facing routes if it stays noisy.

tara: +1 pause. i'm queuing a quick smoke on a warm pod set.

mike: running quick curl trace against canary: ```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \\ \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\ \n  -d '{"model":"embed-service","input":"long text..."}' | jq '.latency'\n```\n
mike: results: 3 samples -> [320, 298, 335]ms. reproduces.

sophia: I've toggled deploy-bot -> pause-rollout for embed-service. Traffic now locked at 10%. deployment state: PAUSED. :white_check_mark:

jen: decision: hold and pin. revert routing for the production embedding alias to v3.4.0 for now. create rollback ticket and annotate release notes.

tara: creating ticket: https://go/repo/issue/INF-8271 with logs and p95 plot. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

obs-bot: Added timeline annotation on SLO dashboard: "canary v3.5.0 staged 10% — paused due to p95 drift". snapshot id=sn-20240822-1810.

mike: quick mitigation idea: temporarily reduce batch size to 8 and enable kv-cache warmup. should test on canary before promoting.

tara: agree test on canary. if good we can reintroduce with config tweak rather than full rollback.

jen: record action items: (1) pin alias -> v3.4.0 (done) (2) eng-runtime to try batch-size tweak on canary (mike) (3) eng-ml to sanity-check model perf with long tokens (tara) (4) update release notes: mention pin and follow-up (jen).

mike: i'm scheduling a 20m quick window to test batch-size change against canary pods. will post results here.

sophia: thanks team. will keep monitoring SLOs and escalate if error rate grows. :handshake:

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by sophia. current_traffic=10%. pinned_alias=embed-prod -> v3.4.0. event_id=rb-1748129999-1

jen: small note for release notes: "v3.5.0 rollout paused at 10% due to p95 regression; pinned to v3.4.0 for production routes. eng-runtime investigating batching warmup as mitigation."

tara: attaching raw traces and sample payloads to INF-8271.

mike: test complete: batch_size=8 on canary -> p95 samples [295, 280, 305]ms. improvement but still slightly above baseline. posting full plot in ticket.

jen: ok — leave canary paused. we'll iterate on cache warmup + kernel tweaks. reopen rollout only after p95 within 2% of baseline for 15m.

sophia: noted. closing this thread for the immediate deploy window. will reopen if alerts recur. :lock:
